item.title: iOS Simulator
item.description:
The iOS Simulator skill lets Claude drive Apple’s Simulator directly — building the app, navigating its screens, and exercising flows the way a developer would during manual QA.

Why a skill for this

iOS development often has no equivalent to a browser’s headless test runner conveniently available mid-conversation. This skill closes that gap by giving Claude a controllable simulator instead of relying on the developer to manually verify every change.

item.title: Expo Skills
item.description:
Expo Skills is the official skill set from the Expo team for building React Native apps with Expo, covering the framework’s specific conventions and tooling.

Why a skill for this

Being maintained by the Expo team itself means the skill tracks the framework’s actual conventions and release changes, rather than a third party’s best guess at Expo’s current best practices.
